thread:
matt: Heads-up — vendor fed back that H200 lead times moved to 22–26 weeks for EU racks. L40S allocation for cloud partners also constrained. We should revisit Q4 reservation ask.

sarah: ugh. do we know whether that's supplier-side or customs/boardings? :confused:

matt: vendor says chipset allocation, not customs. H100s unaffected. Quote: "allocation shift due to fab scheduling".

kevin: numbers we are tracking: current committed H200 slots = 48 racks -> ~4608 GPU-weeks committed per quarter. need to model impact on throughput.

jin: can we convert part of H200 ask to L40S fallback? perf delta varies by model. for small-context chat it's ok, for long-seq generative it's worse.

sarah: Also network egress for EU-onprem is still flaky; passing more traffic to NA increases egress cost 2x.

matt: proposal: reduce H200 reserve by 20% in EU, shift 30% to global pooled L40S + spot H100 burst. keep safety buffer for canary.

alexa: cost check — H200 reserved per month = $Xk/rack; L40S reserved = $Yk/rack. switching mix reduces monthly commit by ~18% but increases per-inference latency for some jobs.

kevin: quick sim attached:
```
inputs:
- baseline throughput: 1.0M tokens/day
- Q4 peak: +40%
options:
A) hold H200 as-is -> cost +22%, latency 1.0x
B) mix H200(60)/L40S(30)/H100-spot(10) -> cost +3%, latency 1.12x
C) convert to H100-heavy -> cost -8%, latency 1.25x for long seq
```

matt: thanks. can ops run cluster health sim w/ our KV cache hit rates? if cache hit stays >85% L40S mix looks OK.

infra-bot: Incident alert: eu-east interconnect errors increased 0.8% over last 12h — routing fallback to eu-west in place.

jin: we should factor interconnect risk. if eu-east degraded, you'll see 6-10% throughput hit during reroutes.

sarah: recommend: run 2-week canary with 20% traffic on L40S pool + telemetry on latency by model family. ops: agree?

kevin: agree. will schedule capacity reservations & create rollout plan.

matt: ok, i'll update procurement ask and notify finance about revised commit. tagging @sarah @kevin for follow-ups :thumbsup:

sarah: added to my calendar — we should include cost/latency thresholds for auto-fallback.
